blocks.text: Edit src/index.ts, rebuild orbital-lessons and run npm run academy:build to embed it in the game. Content is independent from the reusable runner and UI. Increment a lesson version when its completion criteria change, or the course version when progress must be separate. Practice uses compatible Primus/Parvus bodies and selected analytic flight. Unsupported custom worlds get diagnostics. Future automatic interplanetary transfers, 3D inclination, N-body/Lagrange dynamics and aerodynamic reentry are outside this course’s current simulated exercises.
